record.edic_text:
2949 kuma {koo'-mah}

from kuo (to swell [with young], i.e bend, curve);; n n

AV - wave 5; 5

1) a wave (swell) esp. of the sea or of a lake
   1a) of impulse and restless men, tossed to and fro by their
       raging passions

For Synonyms see entry 5857
